title: Intebe y'Ubwami Yagenze mu kanya gato
intro: Umuntu w’umutegetsi ukomeye yategekaga ubwami bukize bwari bufite ubutunzi burenze urugero. Ubwo havukaga ikibazo kitunguranye, uyu mutegetsi yahuye n’ikigeragezo kitari icy’inkota ahubwo cy’ubwenge n’ukwizera. Ibyari kuba byaturutse ku isonga ry’ubutegetsi bw’isi bikagera ku guhinduka gukomeye k’umutima.
clues: Nategetse ubwami bwari bufite ubutunzi n'iterambere rirenze uko umuntu yabyibwira
Nari umwami ukomeye wahawe ibaruwa ikomeye isaba ko yoherezwa
Abatware banjye bangiriye inama ku bijyanye no kurwana cyangwa kugirana amahoro n'uyu mwami wa kure
Nagiyeyo mfite impano nziza cyane kugira ngo njye ubwanjye nsanganire uyu mwami wa kure
Intebe yanjye y'ubwami yagejejwe mu gihugu cya kure mu kanya gato, mbere yuko ngaruka
Ubwo ninjiraga mu ngoro ifite hasi imeze nk'ikirahure, amaherezo natangaje ko nemeye kugandukira Allah

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
